stackDivergence.rationale: Task70 implements both original plain/hinted input-range set overloads and the complete single/multi-block dispatch, previous/next block transfers, metadata and original macro/value/event/iterator ordering. The existing actual nested block_slot_type is supplied as an erased native type witness; external mdds imports no sc/svl and owns no parallel cell store. main_def.range.ts maps the original main_def.inl range family and unchanged insert_empty_impl body under the authored file budget, using original loop-unrolling and actual primitive size-field updates before iterator construction. Whole unchanged normal-only native headers and complete genuine SharedString/CellTextAttr sources match full scalar23968-case, owned special-member and Calc refcount/text streams. Original empty-input-before-hint, unsigned input-end arithmetic and exact diagnostics are retained. Prefix replacement intentionally emits no block events, and original unique_ptr null/throw cleanup is checked through caller-only trait failure injection. The original nonempty-first/different-last partial erase intentionally does not add overwrite_values. These are bounded initialized native witnesses, not full generic allocator/throwing/undefined/ABI/debug/trace/upstream QA or module/kernel/UI certification. Only the exact original CellTextAttrTraits declaration is witnessed; full sc mtvelements.hxx pointee graph is not compiled. Actual formula/edittext/CellStoreType/ScColumn/Table/Document/edit/undo/input/view/UI remain required. Last full61; next full71.
